notes.title: Our Cozy Devlog Series Begins! 🍲🎮
notes.content:
[p]Hey there! 👋[/p][p][/p][p]We're a couple making [b][i]Malhaar[/i][/b] — a cozy narrative RPG set in a riverfront town in India.[/p][p][/p][p]Starting this week, we’ll be sharing our journey through short devlogs — cozy little snippets of how we’re building the game, designing the world, and bringing the characters to life.[/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ We’ll be posting [b]1–2 short devlogs each week[/b] on YouTube — from rainy inspirations to behind-the-scenes moments.[/p][p][/p][p]🎥 [b]Watch Devlog #0 here:[/b]
👉 [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/shorts/o3SKPwAYTB8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]🫖 Whether you're into cozy games, Indian stories, or just curious how two people are building a world from scratch — we’d love to have you follow along.[/p][p][/p][p]And don’t forget to wishlist [b][i]Malhaar[/i][/b] if you haven’t already 🌧️[/p][p]→ ❤️ [url="https://https://store.steampowered.com/app/3581900/Malhaar_From_the_Banks_of_the_Sindhu/"]Wishlist Malhaar on Steam[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav Sale, featuring Malhaar!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce [b]Malhaar[/b]'s participation in the Comic Con x Indie Game Utsav Steam sale!


The sale includes over a 100 Games being showcased! The top indie developers from across the country are coming together and this event is connecting them with top global publishers who are looking to partner.

This also gives Indian gamers a chance to experience the best homegrown games.

It runs from 10th to 20th of April on Steam. Just a few days remaining now. Make most of it✨


Thank you!
